reason: Host agent thread limit prevented reliability and required finish-leaf dispatch after active work completed; six reviewer artifacts remain, and detached peer was reaped, waited, and cleaned without fold-in.

testing_gaps: The inherited READY component test constructs createStorageIntents with ownerScope directly; no test reads an inherited component object through createRpcRuntime -> createComponentStorageRuntime -> storageForScope. A miswired applicationNamespace or component scope at the production entry point would escape these assertions.

The real Neon fork test exercises root storage intents only. Component inherited READY access and sibling component isolation are covered with the local provider fixture, not against a live Neon fork.

residual_risks: The exported ObjectStorageBackend.signDownload interface adds an optional origin argument, while createStorageIntents now passes it for inherited ready rows. Existing custom backend implementations can still type-check while ignoring the origin; branch-specific backends would then fail to download inherited objects. The reviewed tests exercise only the updated Neon adapter.
